scenes.title: Kafka Connect
scenes.subtitle: Moving data in and out without writing code
scenes.narration: Kafka Connect is a framework for streaming data between Kafka and external systems using reusable, configurable connectors.

scenes.title: How Connect Works
bullets: Source connectors pull data into Kafka topics
Sink connectors push data out to external stores
Connectors run as scalable, distributed tasks
scenes.narration: Source connectors pull data from systems like databases or files into Kafka topics. Sink connectors do the reverse, pushing topic data out to stores such as data warehouses or search indexes. Connectors run as distributed tasks across a Connect cluster, so they scale and recover automatically. Best of all, you configure them with JSON instead of writing and maintaining your own integration code.

scenes.title: A Source-to-Sink Pipeline
steps: Data lands in a Kafka topic
Sink connector writes to a warehouse
scenes.narration: A typical pipeline chains connectors together. A source connector reads changes from a database and publishes them to a Kafka topic. Stream processing jobs can then transform or enrich that data in flight. Finally, a sink connector writes the results into a data warehouse or another downstream system, all coordinated through Kafka.

scenes.title: Deploying a Sink Connector
scenes.narration: Kafka Connect exposes a REST API on port 8083 for managing connectors. This request registers a JDBC sink named warehouse-sink that reads the orders topic and writes rows into a PostgreSQL analytics database. Auto-create lets it build the target table automatically. Setting tasks.max to three spreads the work across three parallel tasks for higher throughput.

scenes.text: Connect turns integration into configuration. Hundreds of ready-made connectors let you build pipelines fast, with built-in scaling and fault tolerance.
scenes.narration: Kafka Connect matters because it turns integration into configuration. Hundreds of ready-made connectors let you build pipelines quickly, with scaling and fault tolerance handled for you.
